changes: Added a separately keyed authenticated high-water witness for content-state sequence and fair-scan epoch.
Rejects older valid state, v2 witness loss, and key+state deletion while enrollment survives.
Consumes prior exact receipts and exposes unchanged, changed, new, missing, and incomplete transitions in bounded alerts and health.
Replaced suffix-only exclusion with suffix, magic, exact identity, and a prior unchanged authenticated receipt; unproved containers are non-green.
Added fixed-window entropy fraction scoring that detects deterministic 50-percent strided encryption.
Added a durable sorted-directory rotation epoch so repeated budget pressure cannot deterministically starve one tail forever.
assurance_boundary: A coherent replacement of every local key, state, and witness remains indistinguishable without TPM or remote monotonic authority; loaded local-only state is explicitly capped at health 90.

changes: Added an optional independently administered monotonic high-water contract for custody sequence/head digests.
Independent history blocks total local deletion, coherent rollback, and local key/witness substitution as recovery-required.
Applies and verifies required service/admin-only ACLs on the quarantine directory and each evidence object before packaged capture succeeds.
Added typed captured_unverified outcomes so userspace link-topology uncertainty is never represented as immutable evidence.
Health exposes freshness, ACL proof, capture outcome, and prior-history-erasure risk; local-only custody is capped conservatively.
assurance_boundary: Verified ACLs separate ordinary users from custody. An administrator-equivalent actor can still replace all local software authority or mutate local evidence; administrator-resistant preservation requires TPM/remote monotonic authority plus minifilter or append-only/WORM replication.
